name: stack
description: Vertical flex flow with token-bound gap. The headless equivalent of `<div className="flex flex-col gap-X">` with consistent spacing scale.

props.name: gap
props.description: Vertical spacing between children, bound to `--gap-*` tokens.

variants.name: gap
variants.description: Vertical gap between children, bound to `--gap-*` tokens.

values.description: First child to top, last to bottom, even distribution.

examples.title: Form sections
examples.description: Lg gap separates labelled groups; nested Stack with sm gap groups label+input.

examples.title: Centered hero
examples.description: Center children horizontally for a centered call-to-action stack.

ai.whenToUse: Use anywhere you'd write `flex flex-col gap-X`. Default for vertical lists of dissimilar items (label + input + helper text), section bodies, sidebar items, button groups stacked vertically.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use for tabular data — use `<table>` or DataTable. Don't use for grid-like layouts — use `Grid`. Don't reach for `Stack` when a single child needs no spacing — just render the child.
commonMistakes: Setting `gap="md"` then adding `mt-*` / `space-y-*` on individual children — pick one spacing system
Using `align="center"` and wondering why children expand to full width — that's the `stretch` default for cross-axis
Nesting Stack inside Stack with the same gap when one Stack with two children would suffice
ai.accessibilityNotes: Stack is presentational. Wrap stacked navigation links in a `<nav>`, stacked form fields in a `<form>`, etc. — Stack does not contribute landmark semantics.
